decisions.reason: The cofiber exactness axiom evaluated the functor on C_f for every continuous map between CW complexes, although such a mapping cone need not carry the required CW structure. Restricting this datum and axiom to based cellular maps makes C_f a based CW complex and restores type correctness without changing the functor's map category.

The proof identified the absolute-skeleton D-term h*(X^p) with the relative filtration group h*(X,X^{p-1}), so its displayed multiplicativity identity was ill-typed. The repair uses the relative tower W_p=h*(X,X^{p-1}) and its cofiber E1 terms, whose compatible pairings are exactly Dugger's filtered-space construction; differential compatibility then gives the first-page Leibniz rule.

The incidence-matrix conclusion did not follow using arbitrary independently supplied suspension isomorphisms, because the proof had not related them to the pair connecting maps defining d1. The repair constructs boundary-normalized sphere identifications recursively from the oriented disk-pair connecting isomorphisms; naturality then reduces every component to the incidence-degree map, including the oriented endpoint difference in degree one.

The proof claimed a choice-free operation while outsourcing representative-independence to a lemma that assumes AC. The repaired proof uses the canonical 0/1 residue lifts: for cohomologous cocycles c'=c+du mod 2, their integral lifts differ from c+du by a unique even cochain 2h, which gives a'=a+dh and proves descent in ZF.

For even-dimensional spheres an even total-degree diagonal has two Z graded pieces, not one. The correct filtration is 0 to Z to K^t(S^n) to Z to 0; it splits because restriction to the basepoint has a section induced by the collapse S^n to a point. The reduced summand is therefore Z while the unreduced group is Z direct-sum Z.

The cited interfaces did not provide a componentwise decomposition of the entire K-AHSS. The needed conclusion is narrower: naturality makes d3 restrict to zero on every connected component, and singular cochains on the finite disjoint union split as the product of the component cochain complexes, so H^3 restriction is injective and d3 is zero globally.

The proof treated an exact-couple element as a Postnikov partial lift without constructing a comparison, and it misstated a space-level k-invariant definition as applying directly to spectra. The repair invokes Maunder's differential-compatible comparison of skeletal and representing-space Postnikov spectral sequences, then applies ordinary obstruction theory only to connected spaces ku_m with m at least two.

The finite cellular comparison is true without choice, but the item cited it through a theorem whose stated interface assumes AC for its general infinite-CW conclusion. The repair instead derives consecutive-skeleton concentration and the finite comparison directly from choice-free singular cohomology axioms and finite additivity.

The source does prove the odd-dimensional result, but the recorded premise exposed only the even-dimensional power calculation and an ambiguous odd-groups clause. The repair records Atiyah's restriction isomorphism from RP^{2m+1} to RP^{2m}, which transports the tautological generator and its exact order.

The displayed top-degree Gysin segment permits a nonzero cokernel and therefore cannot itself prove H^{2N+2}=0; invoking the desired vanishing as part of the same induction is circular. The repair obtains all additive groups and the top vanishing independently from the finite CW homology calculation and UCT before applying Gysin to identify multiplication by x.

The conjugation supplier is scoped to numerable bundles over a path-connected paracompact Hausdorff CW base, so the unqualified phrase 'every complex bundle' overstated its interface. The two-torsion argument itself is valid once the statement and fact are aligned with those hypotheses.

Statement 2 compares orientations and does not itself assert an Euler-class identity. The boundary case becomes valid only by combining that orientation comparison with the Euler Whitney product formula and the independently supplied normalization e(0)=1.

The cited comparison and orientation interfaces are stated for actual CW bases, while the example's parenthetical extension to arbitrary CW-type bases had no transfer argument. Removing that unsupported extension leaves every displayed identity fully covered by the dependencies.

The proof's AC accounting omitted two actual uses: the infinite-projective-space cohomology computation in step 1.2 and the Kunneth isomorphism in step 4.1 both have AC-qualified interfaces. The mathematical classification remains valid under the theorem's standing AC assumption.

The supplied cutoffs are strict inequalities: c_i is forced to vanish only for i>m and p_i only for 2i>n. Equality is the top potentially nonzero case. The item also overreached to arbitrary CW-type bases although the Pontryagin supplier is scoped to paracompact Hausdorff CW bases.

The cited bundle-operations definition constructs same-field sums and tensor products but does not define scalar extension, so it did not license the essential isomorphism (E⊕F)_C ≅ E_C⊕F_C. The repair constructs the distributivity map fiberwise, verifies tensor balancing, and checks the complexified block transition matrices explicitly.

The general clutching theorem retains left and right disk-extending gauge changes, but its specialized complex q≥2 clause explicitly identifies bundle classes with π_{q-1}(GL_n(C)). Here q=2 and n=1; both gauge restrictions are nullhomotopic, GL_1(C) is connected and abelian, so isomorphic line bundles have homotopic clutching loops exactly as F1 uses.

The Thom-class definition imposes only a normalization condition and explicitly proves neither existence nor uniqueness, so the global class used to determine the sign was unavailable. The repair adds the oriented-bundle Thom isomorphism, checks its hypotheses for the hyperplane line on CP^1, and transports its unique normalized class to the total-space pair.

The finite-CW-pair theory did not apply merely from compact cofibration data for (CP^r,C_i), and the reduced-product definition was overstated as a ready-made relative-pair interface. The repair invokes the actual compact Hausdorff closed-cofibration exact sequence and derives the relative product from well-pointed quotients, the reduced external product, and the based diagonal.

The splitting theorem states injectivity only with integral and finite-field coefficients, and integral injectivity alone does not justify the rational claim on its CW-type total space. The Chern-character definition does contain a separate stagewise rational Leray--Hirsch proof; the repair cites and propagates that argument through the common flag tower explicitly.

The repaired argument keeps W_p=h*(X,X^{p-1}) distinct from the absolute-skeleton exact-couple terms, verifies the tower and cofiber pairings, and obtains d1 Leibniz from the cited pairing of spectral sequences. Focused precheck and rendercheck passed after normalizing display source lines.

The item now proves cocycle-representative independence directly from unique coefficientwise residue lifts, removes the AC-dependent independence lemma from its dependencies, and corrects the unused erroneous mod-four lift. Focused precheck passed.

The revised extension paragraph treats odd and even sphere dimensions separately, records both even-dimensional graded pieces, and proves the only two-piece extension splits through the basepoint retraction. Focused precheck passed.

The proof now uses only component inclusions and an explicit finite-disjoint-union singular-cochain decomposition to detect the target class; it no longer asserts an unsupported decomposition of the spectral sequence. Focused precheck passed.

The revised proof separates spectrum data from the connected representing spaces, translates to rows q at most -2, and uses the actual skeletal/Postnikov comparison before evaluating the space k-invariant as a cellular obstruction. Focused precheck passed.

The repaired facts now expose exactly the choice-free axioms used on finitely many relative cells, and the proof performs the finite skeleton exact-sequence chase without importing the AC-qualified infinite theorem. Focused precheck passed.

The revised proof separates the even computation from the odd restriction isomorphism, checks that the tautological generator restricts correctly, and handles the m=0 boundary case before using the power-order argument. Focused precheck passed.

This proves x^{N+1}=0 noncircularly without a B-page dependency. Focused precheck and rendercheck passed.

The item now states numerability and the paracompact Hausdorff CW-base hypotheses explicitly and restates the conjugation formula only on that exact domain. The odd-degree sign argument then proves twice the Chern class is zero. Focused precheck passed.

The boundary paragraph now states the rank-zero orientation conclusion first, then derives the optional Euler identity from F4 and F7 with explicit citations. No unsupported Euler formula is attributed to statement 2. Focused precheck passed.

The example is now explicitly scoped to a path-connected CW base, matching F1, F2, and F4; within that scope the Euler, orientability, and mod-two comparison steps are correctly typed. Focused precheck passed.

A1 and the boundary audit now enumerate the AC-qualified F7 and F8 uses in addition to classification, representability, fibration, and Euler inputs. The proof makes no claim of a stronger choice-free result. Focused precheck passed.

The boundary audit now distinguishes strict cutoff from equality and explicitly notes that top classes may be nonzero. The base scope was also aligned with the real Pontryagin interface. Focused precheck passed.

The proof now supplies a well-defined inverse pair on tensor fibers, verifies continuity and transition compatibility in local charts, and only then applies Chern Whitney multiplication. Its base scope also matches the repaired odd-Chern supplier. Focused precheck passed.

The exact rank-one complex sphere case was checked against the full clutching supplier, including its gauge criterion and specialized π1 classification. The degree, tensor-product, dual, and Chern-class steps are all correctly typed, so the item was not edited. Focused precheck passed.

The revised proof obtains the disk Thom class from the actual existence-and-uniqueness theorem, uses the pair homotopy equivalences to define its unique total-space preimage, and then completes the local positive-intersection calculation. Focused precheck passed.

The coordinate-face collars now establish the exact compact/cofibration hypotheses, F1 cites the applicable K^0 quotient sequence, and the support product is explicitly constructed from compact well-pointed quotient spaces. The Bott-generator induction is consequently licensed. Focused precheck passed.

F2 now keeps the integral splitting interface exact and obtains rational injectivity from the direct Leray--Hirsch argument already proved in the Chern-character definition at each projective stage. The root calculations therefore descend legitimately. Focused precheck passed.
